name: HClap
description:
808/909 analog hand clap on a phrase pad. Hold to run. X = hit density (2-and-4 toward every 16th), Y = 808 toward 909.
Still being fine-tuned; the official release is coming soon.

params.name: DENS
params.detail: Euclidean hits per bar, rotated onto beats 2 and 4 (1–16, then 32nd flams)

params.name: TYPE
params.detail: 808 (bottom: analog noise, one VCA) to 909 (top: LFSR, dual VCA)
